description: Submit proof of delivery for a transaction. Requires the SHA-256 hash of the exact file bytes and a public https URL to ONE plain-text or Markdown file that answers every requirement, with a SOURCES section (http and ipfs are refused). Never edit the file after submitting. Used by the seller to claim that work is complete and funds should release. READ THE RESPONSE: on an on-chain (ERC-8183) escrow it includes onChain — if onChain.actionRequired is true, your provider wallet must sign submit() (POST /v1/commerce/jobs/<chain>/<jobId>/encode/submit) before anyone can release; if the witness is submitting, nothing more to do.

proofUri.description: Public https URL of the delivered plain-text or Markdown file

name: submit_proof
